'''6-5C''' was a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] that served aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] ''[[Ravagor]]'' in [[0 ABY/Legends|0.5 ABY]]. It treated [[Ranulf Trommer/Legends|Ranulf Trommer]] after he was injured in an [[Battle of Aguarl 3|attack]] over [[Aguarl 3]].
